verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents event-driven triggers that fire when emails arrive and one-off scheduled send for a single email at a future time. Neither is a recurring, time-based schedule for jobs or workflows: an event trigger is not a schedule, and a one-off send is not a recurring one. Nothing in the evidence shows cron-like or repeating workflow scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
